name: St David's Lleithyr Meadow Club Campsite
stayType: Caravan and Motorhome Club touring site
accommodation: 113 touring pitches for caravans and motorhomes (no tent pitches or pods)
suitableFor: Caravan and motorhome travellers; non-members welcome
beachAccess: Just over a mile from Whitesands Bay
confirmedFeatures: Toilet block, electric hook-up, Wi-Fi, laundry, family washroom, accessible shower room, baby changing, dishwashing area, motorhome service point, playground, BBQs allowed
overview: Lleithyr Meadow is a Caravan and Motorhome Club site on the St Davids peninsula, a little over a mile from Whitesands Bay. It has 113 touring pitches with hook-ups and a full facilities block, and non-members can book. It is touring-only, so there are no tent pitches.
surfTripFit: For anyone travelling by campervan or motorhome it puts Whitesands just over a mile away, with laundry and a service point for longer trips.
